spec.source: R69 historical K27 N8 48 rows, 24 unique names, 2 same-sized checkpoints, 3 hash holdout seeds, artificial region first-letter parity. Actual fixed-coefficient graph calibration; no fresh model, physical HFL, SD rollouts, GPU, timing, CI. Each graph uses donors/receivers by training mean r-q sign, row cap .95, nonnegative alpha, ridge .005||alpha||², lambda flow; projected GD 100 steps per fit, backtracking. Adaptive graph chooses groups of four edges using current train gradient; global vs regional graph storage different, sharedGraphRegional vs regionadaptive match max edge count per region. Oracle max flow permits context-dependent coefficients, restricts to true surplus/deficit edges, undirected oracle can choose direction by teacher, still true bipartition per context. Verify expected outgoing edge count q-weighted, hardGrad expected incident count teacher-r-weighted, not actual CE training speed; soft teacher uses all gradients. No physical hierarchy learning. R93 comparator from separate fit, not matched parameter/cost. Finite difference on analytically affine probability using log1p, not independent autograd check; off-incidence checks use actual predictions. First run naive absolute-eps FD had max abs error 3.306; corrected scale-aware audit, all configurations rerun, not independent evidence.
